name: Ragdoll Boxing 3D [SEASON 1]
desc:
🥊 REAL PHYSICS BOXING 🥊
No canned animations. Every punch, slip and knockout is pure physics. Land the clean shot and watch them fold.

🔥 HUGE UPDATE
• STORY MODE: an island tournament, 24 fighters, one crown
• RANKED: climb from Bronze to Champion and earn your belt
• SPIN YOUR BUILD: height, wingspan and weight change how you fight, up to 7'0"
• 2V2 TAG TEAM, Season Pass, Level Road and daily quests
• KO effects, glove trails, emotes, tattoos and hair

⚔️ HOW TO WIN
Knock them down 3 times. Block, weave, lean back and counter. Clean head shots hit hardest.

🎮 CONTROLS
PC: WASD move · Arrows or mouse punch · F block · Q / E weave · Shift lean back
Controller: L2 / R2 hooks · R1 uppercut · L1 overhand · B block · Y / A weave · X lean back
Mobile: punch buttons or swipes (move or hide any button in Settings)

New? Press TUTORIAL on the home screen.
Codes and news: see our community links on this page!

llm.loop: queue into a fight -> physics-based boxing (punch, block, weave, lean back) -> knock opponent down 3 times -> earn money/XP and rank -> spin builds and unlock cosmetics
llm.objectives: win fights by three knockdowns, climb ranked from Bronze to Champion, win the story-mode island tournament
llm.progression: ranked tiers and belts, levels, season pass, level road, daily quests, cosmetics
llm.instructions: knock opponents down 3 times; block, weave, lean back and counter; head shots hit hardest; press TUTORIAL if new
unique: no canned animations, all punches and knockouts are ragdoll physics
